notice: Project-authored condensed descriptors for every source dimension and score point. Not a verbatim official rubric or validated scoring instrument.

focus_organization.4: Strong topic/book opening and opinion; well-organized reasons with textual evidence, linking phrases and a closing restatement.
focus_organization.3: Introduces topic/book, states opinion, gives reasons, links them and concludes.
focus_organization.2: Unclear focus, partly irrelevant reasons, weak linking or conclusion.
focus_organization.1: Unclear focus, at most one reason, absent linking and conclusion.

conventions.2: Use simple/compound sentences, suitable capitalization and spelling, commas and apostrophes for contractions/possession; errors are not systematic.
conventions.1: Errors can obscure meaning; inconsistent punctuation, capitalization or spelling.

scope_notes: Publication version is not established by the source catalog.
These are classroom descriptors, not a national proficiency standard.
total_policy: Display-only unweighted sum; no cross-provider score conversion or proficiency decision.
not_scorable_policy: Source NS row; all scores null. Illegibility cannot be inferred from typed text.
